scope: Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle (2nd ed.), Chapter 8: Monetary Policy in the Open Economy, with Appendix 8.1 and Exercises 8.1-8.2. Home-bias CES preferences and their Cobb-Douglas limit; price and exchange-rate identities; complete-markets risk sharing on an event tree; uncovered interest parity; aggregate demand and supply of the small open economy; the open-economy Taylor rule, determinacy and monetary-shock responses; optimal policy in the special case (strict domestic inflation targeting) with the second-order welfare criterion; simple rules; and the exercises.
source: Jordi Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle: An Introduction to the New Keynesian Framework and Its Applications, 2nd ed., Princeton University Press, 2015, Chapter 8, pp. 223-260.
